# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P88](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0088), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher at Brierley School  <sub>[v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Thorne  <sub>[v1 c15 P88](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0088), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003)</sub>; Miss Agnes Thorne  <sub>[v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

She is a young lady with light, exceedingly exquisite curly hair, captivating eyes, and a refined, gentle spoken tone. She dresses in gorgeous attire featuring the puffiest sleeves in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002)_

## Personality

She is intelligent, compassionate, and refined, possessing a gentle spoken manner that captures and holds the love of her students. She draws forth her pupils' finest intellectual and moral qualities through encouragement, open-minded guidance, and tactful instruction rather than strictness. Independent and dedicated, she values the progress of her students so deeply that she chooses to remain at Brierley School rather than accept a position in her home district.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P2](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0002)_

## Traits

- Intelligent  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- Compassionate  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- Refined and gentle-mannered  <sub>[v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002)</sub>
- Tactful and encouraging  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c31 P2](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0002)</sub>
- Dedicated to her pupils  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## Abilities

- Effective teaching and academic instruction  <sub>[v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006)</sub>
- Inspiring and disciplining students through moral guidance rather than physical punishment  <sub>[v1 c20 P30](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0030), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- Organizing educational field days, recitations, and physical culture exercises  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- To capture her students' love and draw out their best intellectual and moral qualities  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- To guide her advanced students to successfully pass the Regent's entrance examination  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>
- To raise funds for a schoolhouse flag through a student Christmas concert  <sub>[v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010)</sub>

## History

Agnes Thorne is hired as the first female teacher at Brierley School, taking over the classroom in autumn. She quickly earns the affection and devotion of her pupils, including Nell Harcourt, through her gentle and encouraging methods. She introduces novel educational activities such as field days for studying nature, physical culture exercises, and bi-weekly recitation afternoons. After catching Nell reading a novel during class, she gently reprimands her for dishonesty and time-misuse, securing Nell's promise to refrain from reading inappropriate books. During the autumn, she organizes a student Christmas concert in the hall to raise funds for a schoolhouse flag, which proves to be a grand success. She also forms an extra study class after school hours for her advanced pupils—Nell, Hugh Carrow, Opal Pettigrew, Odette Pullen, Flossie Tulk, Wilfred Mott, and Elias Purdy MacKinnon—to prepare them for the Regent's Entrance Examination. Though offered a position at her home district's grade school at the end of the year, she chooses to remain at Brierley to see her entrance class through their final year. She continues to guide her students through their rigorous studies, and at the conclusion of the second year, her entrance class achieves complete success, with Nell winning the Avery Scholarship and Hugh capturing the medal.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P2](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0002), [v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007)_

## Background by volume

- Hired as the first female teacher in Brierley School's history  <sub>[v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003)</sub>
- Received a job offer from her home district's grade school but declined it to stay at Brierley  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## Quotes

> I considered accepting a position at a different school, yet my decision is to return to Brierley. Honestly, my interest in my students here has developed to such an extent that departing proved impossible. Therefore, I will remain and guide you to the end.  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

> However, your efforts have been commendable over the course of this past year, and a fine, cheerful holiday is well earned. Enjoy the outdoors as much as possible and gather a solid supply of wellness, vigor, and drive to sustain you throughout the coming year. Remember, it will be the ultimate test—that final year prior to the Entrance.  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>
